themes_detail.label: Sudden Surge in Park Noise & Skating
themes_detail.summary: Bike/roller/skating complaints and park noise complaints each spiked to 3 this week—a 2300% jump from a near-zero 8-week baseline (0.1 complaints/week)—suggesting a rapid change in park usage or enforcement patterns that warrants immediate investigation.
evidence: Bike/Roller/Skate complaints: 3 this week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.69)
Noise - Park complaints: 3 this week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.69)
Both categories showing identical 2300% spike with high statistical significance
reporting_angles: Which parks are seeing the uptick? Are specific parks (Cadman Plaza, Fort Greene Park) experiencing new skate/bike activity?
Is this a seasonal change, response to new infrastructure, or enforcement gap?

themes_detail.label: Escalating Tree Damage & Death
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints hit 9 last week (554% above 8-week average of 1.4/week), and illegal tree damage spiked to 11 two weeks ago (529% above baseline of 1.8/week), indicating a possible environmental crisis or uncontrolled development impact in the district.
evidence: Dead/Dying Tree complaints: 9 last week vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.69, severity: high)
Illegal Tree Damage complaints: 11 two weeks ago vs. 1.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.72, severity: high)
1270 building permits filed in last 90 days (915 alterations) may correlate with tree damage during construction
reporting_angles: Are the tree complaints clustered around the 395 Flatbush Avenue Ext. or Columbia Heights rezoning projects currently in review?
What is Parks Dept doing about tree preservation during the active construction cycle?

themes_detail.label: Homeless Assistance Calls Spike
themes_detail.summary: Homeless Person Assistance complaints jumped to 37 two weeks ago—a 225% spike from the 8-week average of 11.4/week—suggesting an acute surge in street homelessness or crisis situations requiring urgent social services coordination.
evidence: Homeless Person Assistance complaints: 37 two weeks ago vs. 11.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.84, severity: high)
225% spike indicates sudden change in street conditions or crisis response demand
Recurring CB budget requests for 'Other senior center program requests' suggest chronic gaps in social services
reporting_angles: Which corridors or neighborhoods (Fort Greene vs. Brooklyn Heights) are seeing the most calls?
Is this related to shelter closures, weather, or service gaps in the district?

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining Complaints Rise
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor dining complaints hit 3 last week—a 500% jump from the 8-week average of 0.5/week—suggesting friction between post-pandemic dining expansion and residents over noise, sanitation, or encroachment on public space.
evidence: Outdoor Dining complaints: 3 last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.0, severity: high)
500% spike represents emergence of new complaint category in district
Converges with sustained noise complaints (Noise - Residential: 1699 complaints over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Which commercial corridors (Myrtle Avenue, Flatbush, etc.) have seen the most outdoor dining expansion?
Are residents complaining about specific venues, or is this a broader zoning/sidewalk encroachment issue?

themes_detail.label: Litter Infrastructure Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket complaints spiked to 3 two weeks ago—a 700% jump from the 8-week average of 0.4/week—indicating possible failures in sanitation infrastructure maintenance that may be compounding broader cleanliness issues.
evidence: Litter Basket Complaint: 3 two weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.42, severity: high)
700% spike from near-zero baseline suggests gap in DS maintenance
CB repeatedly requests 'New equipment for maintenance' (Parks Dept) year-over-year, indicating chronic underfunding
reporting_angles: Are specific parks or neighborhoods experiencing litter basket overflow?
Is this tied to the broader parks maintenance equipment request in the CB budget wishlist?
